scope: Qualified starting/recovery environment for this BC-250 and recorded sources; no new speed or universal reliability claim

requirements.observed: Remote v0.1.0 tag and preserved commit/tree verified; installed profile/history retained separately

requirements.requirement: Isolated environment, known-good boot/recovery, backups and disposable volumes
requirements.observed: Physical private root reaches usable target and returns to original root; original config restored; same-SSD read-only root reference and off-device boot archive verified
requirements.limitation: Boot archive plus same-SSD root reference do not qualify full-disk failure or off-device user-data recovery

requirements.requirement: Controller, filesystem, actual devices, memory, thermals and power manifest
requirements.observed: Fresh physical post-return collector maps actual mounted device sources and records negotiated 5 GT/s x2 link and 5000 us policy

requirements.requirement: Fresh install, reapply, remove, reboot and supported resume
requirements.observed: 11 real guest-systemd lifecycle checks, current-source process recovery, physical reboot/return and real policy reapplication verified
requirements.limitation: Real-systemd fixture uses simulated controller sysfs at its recorded source epoch; physical lab deployment remains separate from portable installation. Owner reports no functional target suspend wake; resume excluded, not passed

requirements.requirement: Partial/failed installation, edits, dependencies, hardware refusals and activation interruption
requirements.observed: Current installer/transaction/worker bytes match latest 40 real process-kill matrix; selected cache-loss and identity refusals pass; 121 Linux tests pass after physical return
requirements.limitation: Selected boundaries do not establish arbitrary crash-ordering or physical SSD power-loss correctness

requirements.requirement: Separate B0/B1/B2 volumes with equal logical data and recorded layout differences
requirements.observed: Three independent UUIDs, equal 36646-node logical trees, measured native layouts, zero shared extents and nine startup/persistence/reset phases
requirements.limitation: Loop-backed prepared userspaces are not the future frozen application suite; B0/B1 power-only comparisons must hold layout fixed
